controlled_river_probe.method: Replace simulate in the loaded policy globals temporarily with a fixed equity; restore afterward
controlled_river_probe.note: Controlled decision-rule probe, not equity measured for a particular real hand

preflop_probe.method: simulate(hole, (), (), 20000, float('inf'), Random(981)); fresh RNG for each holding
preflop_probe.opponent_model: Existing random holdings and default discard mixture; no betting evidence
preflop_probe.limitation: Model-conditioned Monte Carlo results, not exact equity against an observed shoving range

historical_final_evaluation.limitation: Shared opponent template; correlated assignments and deal seeds
